Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Settled touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 5 Lengths 800m, came off heels to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , battled on well but lacked winning dash # Even Effort
Jumped Ok , Drifted Back Worse than midfield Two Wide 6 Lengths 800m, stayed back inside soon after Straightening Up , weaved a passage last 200m and finished Just out of placings # not far away

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field in between runners 8 Lengths . Ridden Along into Straight , shifted out to Middle Of Track , only Battled to the line (winner led & bolted in) # never looked likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: JAA. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok then Drifted Back 2nd last 6 Lengths . laid in on Straightening Up , picked up the bit near 150m & ran on well to finish 4th (vet - no visible abnormalities) # did best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: laid in under pressure in the straight. When questioned in relation the tactics he adopted in today’s event, in particular the early stages of the straight, RE in his assessment the inside of the track was slightly firmer than the outside and it would be to his advantage to ride for luck and stay on the inside of the track. He added that SACRED CHORD was inclined to lay in, in the early part of the straight, but once able to obtain clear running the gelding finished the race off strongly. Stewards noted his explanation. Vet NVA.
